_comment: GMP sources, tried in the order listed. Each runs independently — one being down never blocks the others. For a company reported by several sources, the first one listed wins and the rest only fill gaps.

sources.name: investorgain
sources._note: {month}/{year}/{fy} are substituted per run so the URL does not go stale. If it ever starts returning 'API not found', open the GMP page in Chrome, DevTools > Network > Fetch/XHR, and copy the new Request URL here.

sources.name: chittorgarh
sources._note: Same reporting platform as investorgain, so the same adapter works. Capture the URL the same way (DevTools > Network > Fetch/XHR on their GMP page), paste it here and set enabled:true. Having a second source means a single site being down no longer costs you GMP.

sources.name: custom
sources._note: Generic HTML table reader for any other source you are permitted to read. Check the site's robots.txt and terms first.
